study_label: Auditory peripersonal space in humans. (a)
title: Auditory peripersonal space in humans.
experiment_label: Experiment 1 — right-side front/back × near/far × sound type
auditory_stimulus: Static free-field wideband white-noise bursts and 1.5-kHz pure tones, level-adjusted to 70 dB at the ear and emitted by a 0.3-W, 8-ohm loudspeaker under sensor/switch control; reusable source waveforms are not supplied.
trajectory_kinematics: Static right-front and right-back sources at 20 or 70 cm from the head, ear level and 45 degrees from the sagittal plane; sound lasts for the tactile contact (brief, under 1 s), so motion speed is not applicable.
trial_sequence: One tactile-only baseline condition plus eight cross-modal blocks (2 sound types x front/back x 20/70 cm). Each 40-trial block used 10 single-left, 10 single-right, 10 bilateral/simultaneous and 10 no-stimulation rows in the same pseudorandom order; the full protocol ran twice.
task_response: After an experimenter attention prompt, participants verbally reported left, right, both, or none after each event, regardless of modality.
jitter_iti_policy: No ITI, inter-trial interval, jitter value, or distribution was recovered after the main-PDF, targeted, fallback, and supplement-route checks.
soa_schedule: Cross-modal sound and touch were simultaneous (nominal 0-ms SOA); there was no varied SOA ladder.
tactile_target: Brief light contact under 1 s with a 1-cm² touch-sensitive sensor on the lateral neck behind the ear, below the mastoid process.
baseline_trial_contract: Tactile-only switch-off baseline with the same manual contact timing: one 40-trial condition x two protocol runs = 80 baseline-block trials (60 tactile-present and 20 no-stimulation).
catch_trial_contract: No-stimulation rows required a 'none' report: 9 conditions x 10 no-stimulation trials x 2 protocol runs = 180, of which 160 were in cross-modal blocks and 20 in tactile-only baseline blocks.
repetition_allocation: Nine condition blocks, each with 10 repetitions of four trial types, repeated in two complete protocol runs: 9 x 40 x 2 = 720 trials per participant (640 cross-modal-block trials and 80 baseline-block trials).
block_order_contract: Nine condition-specific 40-trial blocks per protocol, with condition-block order randomized across sessions and participants; the complete protocol was repeated twice, yielding 18 blocks.

study_label: Dynamic sounds capture the boundaries of peripersonal space representation in humans. (a)
title: Dynamic sounds capture the boundaries of peripersonal space representation in humans.
auditory_stimulus: Pink noise at 44.1 kHz, 3000 ms, generated in SoundForge 4.5. Two identical samples have opposing near/far loudspeaker fades; ear-position levels span 55–70 dB SPL. Original waveform/seed, exact exponential envelope and room/speaker transfer are unavailable.
trajectory_kinematics: IN/OUT apparent motion from two-speaker intensity fades. Right hand rests palm-down beside body; near speaker on table by hand, far speaker on floor approximately 100 cm from near speaker. Sound lasts 3 s. Full 3D geometry and perceived distance–time law are not established.
trial_sequence: A 5000 ms nominal trial comprises 1000 ms silence, 3000 ms IN/OUT sound and 1000 ms silence. Touch may occur during sound or in pre/post silence; those control trials retain sound elsewhere. Auditory-only catches omit touch. Conditions and timings are randomly intermingled.
task_response: Say TAH as rapidly as possible to touch while ignoring sound; withhold when touch is absent. Voice-activated relay with C.I.R.O. records RT. No numeric response timeout or relay latency correction is reported.
jitter_iti_policy: 1000 ms silence precedes and follows each 3000 ms sound. These within-trial windows do not establish an additional inter-trial interval or jitter distribution.
tactile_target: Hairy surface of right index finger receives a single rectangular monophasic electrical pulse through Neuroline electrodes and DS7A. Published p. 3 says 100 µsec, confirmed visually; extracted msec is wrong. Individually suprathreshold intensity, historical tested range 60–90 mA. Trigger/latency details remain unspecified.
baseline_trial_contract: T0/T6 touch occurs at 300/4600 ms from trial start (−700/+3600 ms from sound onset), during silence before/after the same trial’s sound. The sound remains present at trial times 1000–4000 ms. 32 silence-window target trials, not 32 wholly silent trials.
catch_trial_contract: 76 auditory-only catches intermingled with 112 targets.
repetition_allocation: Eight repetitions × seven tactile timings × two sound contexts = 112 targets (80 during sound + 32 in pre/post silence), plus 76 auditory-only catches = 188 main trials. Calibration and the 80-trial localization control are separate.
block_order_contract: 188 main trials equally divided into two blocks of about eight minutes each, with randomized/intermingled sound/timing/catches. Equal division implies 94 rows per block; exact per-cell and catch distribution between blocks is unreported.

study_label: Extended multisensory space in blind cane users. (a)
title: Extended multisensory space in blind cane users.
experiment_label: Static near/far hand PPS with cane and handle conditions
auditory_stimulus: 150 ms white-noise bursts from two identical loudspeakers, equalized to 70 dB at the ear. Spectral waves compared at source origin. Sampling rate, bandwidth, original waveform/seed and onset/offset envelope are unreported.
trajectory_kinematics: Static near/far sounds. Near speaker is close to the right hand; far speaker is on the floor approximately 125 cm away at the cane tip. Cane is 125 cm and handle 14 cm. Exact near distance and full coordinates are unreported.
trial_sequence: Weak tactile targets and strong tactile nontargets are each paired with static near/far sounds; auditory-only catches omit touch. Full trial timing and within-block randomization are unreported.
task_response: Vocal tah to weak touch only; withhold for strong touch and sound-only catches. Voice relay and XGen capture RT. Thirty familiarization trials are separate. No numeric response deadline is specified.
jitter_iti_policy: No ITI, jitter distribution or complete trial-cycle duration found in the full Methods.
soa_schedule: Emission/command SOA under tactile-minus-auditory notation is 0 ms near and +5 ms far. Far audio is emitted 5 ms before touch to compensate acoustic propagation; intended arrival synchrony is a different reference.
tactile_target: Upper side of right index finger, two DS7A constant-current stimulators and two electrode pairs. Weak target calibrated to approximately 90% detection; strong nontarget to 100%. Weak-inside-strong electrode nesting and reverse are split across participant halves. Pulse duration/waveform and individual numeric currents are not reported.
baseline_trial_contract: No extra tactile-only baseline family exists in the enumerated 150-trial allocation: 120 touch-plus-sound target/nontarget trials and 30 sound-only catches. Comparisons use near/far location and tool state.
catch_trial_contract: Thirty sound-only catches per task administration require no vocal response. The 60 strong-touch nontargets are separate no-go trials, not 60 additional paper-labelled catches. Exact near/far sound-only catch allocation is unreported.
repetition_allocation: Thirty trials in each weak/strong × near/far cell plus 30 sound-only catches give 150 per task. Two blind-cohort administrations imply 300 trials; four sighted-cohort administrations imply 600, assuming the described task repeats for every stated condition. Familiarization (30 trials) and training are excluded.
block_order_contract: Both groups complete cane and weight-matched handle conditions in counterbalanced order. Sighted participants additionally perform cane assessments immediately after ten-minute training and one day later. Exact acquisition-block subdivision, within-task shuffle and relation of later sessions to the counterbalanced initial pair are not fully specified.

study_label: Social modulation of peripersonal space boundaries. (a)
title: Social modulation of peripersonal space boundaries.
auditory_stimulus: Pink noise 44.1 kHz, 3 s for Exp 1/2; SoundForge 4.5 opposing near/far fades spanning 55–70 dBSPL at ears. Exact sample/seed and exponential fade function are unavailable.
trajectory_kinematics: IN/OUT apparent motion beside right cheek; near speaker approximately 5 cm from cheek, far 100 cm from near at same height. Sound lasts 3 s with 1 s pre/post silence; source crossfades are not verified metric constant velocity.
trial_sequence: Each trial: 1 s silence, 3 s IN/OUT sound, 1 s silence; touch at one of 5 sound-relative delays or omitted in sound-only catches. Timings/directions randomly combined and catches intermingled.
task_response: Vocal TAH rapidly after right-cheek touch; ignore sounds and withhold on catches. Voice-activated relay/C.I.R.O.; RT subtracts scheduled touch time from trial-relative response. No online timeout reported.
jitter_iti_policy: Fixed 1 s pre/post sound silence belongs to the trial; independent ITI/jitter not reported.
soa_schedule: Touch-minus-audio onsets:+300,+800,+1500,+2200,+2700 ms for both IN/OUT; paired perceived distances reverse with direction.
tactile_target: Right cheek receives 100 μs rectangular monophasic electrical pulse, DS7A/Neuroline. Individual clearly suprathreshold calibration; source tested range 60–90 mA is historical. Trigger/latency absent.
baseline_trial_contract: No separate baseline/control trial family in the enumerated 80 target+24 catch task. Social conditions are experimental contrasts, not silent baseline rows.
catch_trial_contract: 24 sound-only catches per 104 trial experimental condition; withhold response. IN/OUT catch split not stated.
repetition_allocation: 8 repetitions×5 SOAs×2 directions=80 targets, plus 24 catches=104 per social/time condition. Two conditions/timepoints yield 208 per participant, excluding calibration and bargaining tasks.
block_order_contract: Each 104 trial condition divided equally into two approximately 5 min blocks. Exp 1 Other/Mannequin order counterbalanced; within-condition trial order randomized.

experiment_label: Experiment 1A: intensity and near/far audiotactile task
auditory_stimulus: Physical loudspeakers present 100 ms white-noise bursts at near and far locations. Levels are matched to approximately 70 dB above the head; the exact waveform recipe is not supplied.
trajectory_kinematics: Static near/far sources are positioned relative to the right hand. Near is approximately 5 cm from the hand, 50 cm from the torso and 60 cm from the head; far is 100 cm from the near speaker, approximately 150 cm from the torso and 160 cm from the head.

task_response: Blindfolded participants say “tah” quickly for the designated tactile intensity, withhold responses to the other intensity and sound-only catches, and ignore sound. The endpoint is vocal tactile RT.

tactile_target: The right index receives a single rectangular monophasic electrical pulse lasting 100 microseconds. Weak and strong intensities are calibrated individually. The article calls the stimulators constant-current but calls the pulse constant-voltage; retain this unresolved apparatus wording.

auditory_stimulus: Pink noise at 44.1 kHz, duration 3.000 s. Two identical samples crossfaded across near/far loudspeakers; near level rises, far level falls to silence. block_order_contract: Two consecutive blocks use different female confederates. Within each: pre-AT, IMS, post-AT, questionnaire. block_order_contract: Detection procedures precede discrimination. Exact task order/counterbalance is not supplied. Retain the later single-observer session as a protocol variant, not a fourth recruited observer.

task_response: Press a key with the right index finger as fast as possible to touch; ignore sounds and withhold on auditory-only catches.
